scene: The fox yawns, unlocking the back door to three waiting summit departures.
picture: A flat side view along a wide wooden terrace overlooking the hill. Far left, a silver sleigh tram sits idling on snowy mountain rails. Left-centre, the lanky boy in his orange vest and kite stands facing outward. Centre, a glass-bottomed boat floats in a canal slip. Far right, a striped hot-air balloon sways gently.
shown: a silver sleigh tram waiting on snowy rails on the far left
a blue glass-bottomed canal boat moored at the wooden dock in the centre
a striped hot-air balloon basket anchored to posts on the far right
